本地服务没有响应（HTTP {status}）: The local service did not answer (HTTP {status})
同一配方的其他目标可以一键套用: Other targets with the same recipe can use it in one click
下次运行时生效: Takes effect on the next run
这个面板出错了: This panel ran into an error
按流程完整处理这个目标，并和参考作品比较: Process this target from start to finish and compare it with the references
饱和度再高一点，背景再暗一点: A little more saturation and a darker background
和参考作品比一下，还差在哪里？: Compared with the references, what is still missing?
它会读拍摄数据和资料库、按配方跑 PixInsight、看每一步的结果、和高赞作: It reads the capture data and the knowledge base, runs the recipe in PixInsight, looks at every step, compares with top-rated works and tunes the parameters itself. You can also just tell it the look you want.
去设置模型和密钥: Set up a model and key
无视觉模型：只按指标判断: No vision model: judging by the numbers only
告诉 AI 想要什么效果，例如“星点小一点，彗尾再蓝一点”（Enter 发送，S: Tell the AI the look you want, e.g. “smaller stars, a bluer tail” (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
把还没出图的目标排进队列，一个接一个处理：没叠加的先用 WBPP 叠加，再按配方: Queues every target without a finished image and processes them one after another: stacks with WBPP where needed, then runs the recipe. Cancel at any time in the job bar below.
全部完成后会弹出系统通知，可以先去做别的。: A notification tells you when everything is done, so you can do something else meanwhile.
检查每一帧的星点数、星点大小和背景亮度，找出被云、结露、风、跑焦或天亮影响的帧，: Measures every frame's star count, star size and sky brightness to find frames spoiled by clouds, dew, wind, focus or dawn, so they can be left out before stacking.
排除或恢复了帧，现在的叠加结果还是旧的。重新叠加，然后再按配方出图。: Frames were excluded or restored, so the stack is out of date. Stack again, then process with the recipe.
排除的帧移到目标文件夹的 Excluded 里，不会删除，随时可以恢复。可疑是和: Excluded frames move to the Excluded folder of the target: nothing is deleted and they can be restored at any time. Suspicious means compared with this target's other frames: far fewer stars, much larger or elongated stars, or a much brighter sky.
选择拍摄数据所在的文件夹: Choose the folder with your capture data
选一个拍摄文件夹（ASIAIR、NINA、SharpCap 等软件的导出，或者相: Choose a capture folder (from ASIAIR, NINA, SharpCap and the like, or a camera card). Every image's header tells whether it is a light, dark, bias or flat
（单反、微单的 RAW 文件看所在文件夹的名字，比如 Light、Dark、Fl: (for DSLR and mirrorless RAW files the folder name does: Light, Dark, Flat, Bias); frames are sorted by target and night.
校准帧先用同一批拍的，缺的再从校准帧库里找。只有校准帧的文件夹（比如后来补拍的暗: Calibration frames shot with the data come first, the calibration library fills the gaps. A folder of calibration frames only (darks shot later, say) goes to the library and to the targets that lack them.
选择文件夹，或粘贴路径后按回车: Choose a folder, or paste a path and press Enter
或者：查找数据根目录里新放进来的文件夹: Or: look for new folders put in the data folder
原文件夹保持不动，数据目录里放一份。: The original folder stays as it is; the data folder gets a copy.
省磁盘空间：光照帧从原文件夹移走。校准帧总是复制（可能好几个目标都要用）。: Saves disk space: lights move out of the original folder. Calibration frames are always copied (several targets may need them).
这个文件夹里没有可以导入的拍摄数据。: This folder holds no capture data to import.
还没有目标。用“导入新数据”整理一晚拍摄的文件夹，或在设置里指定数据根目录。: No targets yet. Use “Import” to organize a night's capture folder, or choose the data folder in Settings.
打开一个目标文件夹（包含 Light/ 或 Post/）: Open a target folder (one with Light/ or Post/)
本地处理服务（Python）运行正常: The local processing service (Python) is running
本地处理服务（Python）正在连接: Connecting to the local processing service (Python)
磁盘空间：清理可以再生成的中间文件: Disk space: remove intermediate files that can be made again
从一晚的数据到成品图: From a night's data to a finished image
导入拍摄文件夹，astroflow 会自动匹配校准帧、用 WBPP 叠加、按目标: Import a capture folder: astroflow matches the calibration frames, stacks with WBPP, processes in PixInsight with a recipe for the kind of object, and compares with top-rated works of the same target.
每一步的参数都可以调；也可以让 AI 助手替你判断和调参。: Every step's parameters can be tuned, or the AI assistant can judge and tune them for you.
在左侧选择一个目标开始: Choose a target on the left to start
启动时检查新版本: Check for new versions at start
里面有 In Processing、Processed、Dark Library: It holds In Processing, Processed, Dark Library, Bias Library, Flat
PixInsight 脚本写在这里；路径里不能有空格或中文。留空自动选择。: PixInsight's job scripts go here; the path may not contain spaces or Chinese characters. Empty: chosen automatically.
密钥已保存到系统钥匙串: Key saved in the system keychain
输入新密钥以替换: Enter a new key to replace it
密钥存放在系统钥匙串（Windows 凭据管理器 / macOS 钥匙串），不会: Keys are kept in the system keychain (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain); they are never shown or written to the settings file.
器材（FITS 头里缺失时使用，也写进 AI 的提示）: Equipment (used where FITS headers lack it, and told to the AI)
主体色度目标（相对同类参考作品）: Subject colourfulness target (relative to similar references)
Windows 与 macOS 通用；路径和模型保存在本机，密钥存放在系统钥匙串: The same on Windows and macOS; paths and models are kept on this computer, keys in the system keychain.
没能复制，请手动选中复制: Could not copy: select the text and copy it yourself
astroflow 驱动你电脑上的 PixInsight 来处理图像。缺的组件按: astroflow drives the PixInsight on your computer. Install what is missing as described below, then click “Check again”.
必需组件都齐了，可以导入、叠加和出图。: Everything required is in place: import, stack and process away.
还缺 {n} 项必需组件：{names}。补齐之前，叠加和出图会失败。: {n} required component is missing: {names}. Stacking and processing fail until it is in place.
{n} required components are missing: {names}. Stacking and processing fail until they are in place.
拖动方框选择画面，拖右下角调整大小。导出不会改动原来的成品图。: Drag the frame to choose the view, drag its corner to resize it. Exporting leaves the finished image as it is.
第一行是标题。不会写拍摄地点。: The first line is the title. The location is never written.
选比例、框出画面，可以加拍摄信息和署名。导出的 JPG 存在目标的 Post/s: Choose a shape, frame the view, add capture details and a signature if you like. The JPG goes to the target's Post/share folder.
这个目标还没有成品图，先按配方处理。: This target has no finished image yet: process it with its recipe first.
可以删的是 WBPP 的中间单帧和各处理阶段的中间结果，需要时会自动重新生成（重: What can go are WBPP's single-frame intermediates and the stages' intermediate results: they are made again when needed (stacking again, re-running a stage). Raw frames, stacks, finals and share pictures stay.
把整个目标文件夹移到 {dest}。之后它不在左侧列表里，需要时用“打开文件夹”: Moves the whole target folder to {dest}. It then leaves the list on the left; use “Open folder” to open it again.
同时删掉可以再生成的中间文件，释放 {size}: Also remove intermediate files that can be made again: frees {size}
WBPP 的中间单帧和各阶段的中间结果；原始帧、叠加结果和成品都保留。: WBPP's single-frame intermediates and the stages' intermediate results; raw frames, stacks and finals stay.
依次点选两张图（例如我们的成品和一张参考作品）: Click two images in turn (e.g. our final and a reference)
每晚用自己的平场校准，再一起配准叠加。之后又拍了新的一晚，勾上再更新一次。: Each night is calibrated with its own flats, then all are registered and stacked together. Shot another night since? Tick it and update.
合并后一起叠加成一张：总曝光更长，噪点更少。每晚用自己的平场校准，原来的每晚数据: Combined, they stack into one image: more total exposure, less noise. Each night is calibrated with its own flats; the nights' own data stays as it is.
{nights} 已经不在 In Processing（归档或删除了），它的帧还: {nights} left In Processing (archived or deleted); its frames stay in the combined target.
彗星分两步叠加：先用 WBPP 校准和配准（5–20 分钟），再按星点和彗核分别: A comet is stacked in two steps: WBPP calibrates and registers (5–20 min), then stars and nucleus are stacked separately.
第 1 步：WBPP 校准和配准: Step 1: calibrate and register with WBPP
WBPP 已经配准好。下一步按星点和彗核分别叠加，自动处理云、卫星轨迹和长短不一: WBPP has registered the frames. Next, stars and nucleus are stacked separately, dealing with clouds, satellite trails and mixed exposures (about 10–15 min).
这个目标还没有暗场。补拍后把暗场所在的文件夹“导入”进来，会自动补给它；也可以不: This target has no darks yet. Shoot them and “Import” their folder: they are added automatically. Or stack without darks (more noise and hot pixels).
还没有叠加结果：用 WBPP 校准、配准、叠加（5–20 分钟）。: Not stacked yet: calibrate, register and stack with WBPP (5–20 min).
叠加完成。认不出这个目标是什么天体，先选一个处理配方。: Stacked. The object is not recognised: choose a recipe first.
叠加完成，可以按配方出片。: Stacked: ready to process with the recipe.
影响配方选择和参考作品分组: It decides the recipe and which references are compared
抓取同目标高赞作品作参考: Fetch top-rated works of this target as references
饱和度曲线中点（0.5 = 不变，越大越饱和）: Saturation curve midpoint (0.5 = unchanged, higher = more saturated)
黑点处剪掉的像素比例: Share of pixels clipped at the black point
发射星云、反射星云、超新星遗迹等，无滤镜拍摄: Emission and reflection nebulae, supernova remnants and the like, shot without a filter
旋涡星系、椭圆星系、星系群: Spiral and elliptical galaxies, galaxy groups
星云，用多波段 / 窄带滤镜拍摄: Nebulae shot through a multiband / narrowband filter
认不出“{name}”是什么天体（不在内置星表里）。选一个配方，之后就可以调参数: “{name}” is not recognised (not in the built-in catalogue). Choose a recipe, then tune and process:
也可以在 AI 助手里告诉它这是什么天体，让它来选。: Or tell the AI assistant what the object is and let it choose.
从这里运行到最后: Run from here to the end
改动会保存到这个目标，下次运行时生效；重新运行一个阶段会使它后面的阶段失效。: Changes are saved to this target and used on the next run; running a stage again invalidates the stages after it.
还没有{recipe}配方的风格: No styles for the {recipe} recipe yet
把这个目标的参数存为风格…: Save this target's parameters as a style…
先改几个参数，满意后再保存。: Tune a few parameters first, then save them.
记下这个目标改过的 {n} 处参数。以后用{recipe}配方的目标，可以在这里: Keeps the {n} parameter edited for this target. Targets with the {recipe} recipe can then apply it here in one click.
Keeps the {n} parameters edited for this target. Targets with the {recipe} recipe can then apply them here in one click.
已经有这个名字的风格，保存会覆盖它。: A style with this name exists: saving replaces it.
这个目标现在改过的 {n} 处参数会被替换成这个风格的。已经出的图不会变，下次运: The {n} parameter edited for this target is replaced by the style's. Finished images stay as they are; it takes effect on the next run.
The {n} parameters edited for this target are replaced by the style's. Finished images stay as they are; it takes effect on the next run.
下载后可以马上重启安装，也可以等下次关闭 astroflow 时自动安装。设置、: Once downloaded, restart to install it now, or it installs when you next close astroflow. Settings, keys and data are kept.
在下载页下载新的安装包，装好后设置、密钥和数据都会保留。: Download the new installer from the release page; settings, keys and data are kept when you install it.
已经下载好。重启时会先停下正在运行的任务。不想现在重启的话，下次关闭 astro: Downloaded. Restarting stops a running job first. If now is not a good time, it installs when you next close astroflow.
检查或下载新版本时出错：{error}: Checking for or downloading the new version failed: {error}
{title}（浏览器开发模式：输入完整路径）: {title} (browser development mode: enter a full path)
光照帧和校准帧，不会删除: Lights and calibration frames: never removed
WBPP 的主帧，处理从这里开始: WBPP's master frames: processing starts from them
校准、去马赛克、配准后的单帧，重新叠加会再生成: Calibrated, debayered, registered frames: stacking again makes them again
各阶段的中间图（最终成品除外），重跑时自动补回: Every stage's result but the final: re-running makes them again
发射星云、反射星云、超新星遗迹等: Emission and reflection nebulae, supernova remnants and the like
